newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia to up infrastructure investment.
newsitem.headline: Colombia to up infrastructure investment.

text.p: Colombia will increase infrastructure investment to 5.55 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) between now and 1999 compared to 3.9 percent over the last two years, the National Planning Department head said Tuesday.
Department director Cecilia Lopez said private sector participation in infrastructure investment would almost double to a sum equivalent to 2.56 percent of GDP between this year and the end of next.

Speaking at a forum on privatization issues, Lopez said 1997 should see infrastructure investment of about $5 billion, excluding the oil and mining sectors, and about $8 billion if those sectors were taken into account.
Lopez said the private sector had chiefly targetted telecommunications, the power generating sector and highway construction.
